data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ayt', meaning 'to help or support'. In Islamic history, Aytak is a name for someone who is always ready to lend a helping hand, and is considered a virtuous and righteous character. The name Aytak carries the meaning “Helpful, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aytak usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
